summary: Hunt for a 10%/month Panic Buyer design: 5 levers (velocity, faster cycle, wider universe, stacked boosters, idle cash), then a critic

r.lever: velocity: make each dollar do more round trips, using 1-minute data. New 1-minute kernel vkernel in x10_velocity_lib.py, copied from engine.mkernel and rewritten as one minute-by-minute loop. Switches: buy cycle every 1/15/60 minutes; re-arm after a sale; cooldown in minutes; bids only near the trigger; trailing exit on 1-minute closes with a cap; take-profit delay; a sell-side fill penalty. Round 2 adds a second "flash dip" trigger (8% under the highest close of the last 3 closed hours) and re-entry at exit price -3% for 60 minutes after a profitable exit. Round 3 adds a cooldown after losing exits. With the new switches off the kernel reproduces engine.mrun exactly: identical trade logs and equity within 1e-14 relative, on synthetic data and on the real 19 coins, for 6 settings (live, concentrated, take-profit delay, cooldown 0). engine.run gives the same result as engine.mrun with delay 0 on the same candles. Costs: 0.1% fee per side. Market-order slippage is 0.02%, or 0.1% when the coin is outside the trailing-30-day top 50 by quote volume of the 322 screened coins plus FTT (decided per hour). Limit buys need the price to trade 0.1% through. All orders are fully funded from cash: spot only, no leverage.

r.risks:
1. Hindsight. The 10%+ designs were found only after looking at 2024-26 results from rounds 1-2. The 2021-23 rule picked +6.32%/month in round 1 and +5.81% in round 2, and +9.23% inside the round-3 grid, which was itself placed by hindsight. No 2018-20 holdout was used.
2. Fill sensitivity. These designs trade 11-17 times a month with the whole account, at about +0.9-1.5% per trade on average. With fills 0.1% worse on both sides the hindsight best falls from 11.71% to 8.48%/month; with 0.2% worse, to 6.73%. Real fills decide whether 10% exists at all.
3. Concentration. With one coin at 100%, the worst single trade cost -30% of the account in 2024-26 and -56% in 2021-23. Worst drops are -39% (2024-26) and -60% (2021-23).
4. Collapse coins. Most 1-coin designs lose 92-100% of the account in May 2022 once LUNA is included. The 2024-26 figures are measured from the January 2024 balance, so after such a wipe-out they would have needed a new deposit. Only the 168h loss-cooldown variant held its drop to -62%.
5. Regime dependence. About 97% of the 2024-26 profit comes from five volatile coins (RENDER, FET, ARB, SUI, DOGE). 2026 to date is only +3-5%/month for every 10%+ design.
6. Operations. The bot would have to run every minute (cancel/replace orders, trailing logic on minute closes) instead of hourly. That is new code nobody has replayed, and outages hurt more.
7. Compounding. 2021-23 multiples (e.g. 2021 +18,728%) are not achievable at size. RM-scale 2024-26 is fine.
8. The volume-rank slippage pool contains only screened coins, so it understates how often the 0.1% slippage applies.
9. A cache bug (an id()-keyed ref2 array) corrupted early fresh-start jitter runs. It was fixed, and re-running grid2/grid3 designs matched the saved results to within 2e-14.

r.summary:
No honestly chosen design reaches 10%/month. Velocity does help: on the same engine and costs, the pre-registered round-1 pick makes +6.32%/month in 2024-26 with a -27% drop. The earlier 2-coin pick makes +5.52% (-29%) and the live settings +2.89% (-16%). Since 2025 the pick makes +3.72%/month. Each piece helps a little:
- buy cycles every minute, so the slot chases whichever coin dips first;
- a trailing exit on 1-minute closes, armed at +3%;
- 2 coins at 50%.

With hindsight, 22 designs (6 in round 2, 16 in round 3) reach 10% or more in 2024-26. All hold one coin at up to 100% and combine 1-minute cycles, a second "flash dip" trigger (8% under the 3h high), re-entry after a profitable exit, a trailing exit and a 12-24h time stop. The best makes +11.71%/month in 2024-26 (x41.6, drop -39%) and +10.06%/month since 2025. Fresh starts in January 2024 keep it between +11.2% and +11.9%.

The 10% does not hold up under stress:
- With fills 0.1% worse it falls to +8.5%; with 0.2% worse, to +6.7%.
- A LUNA-style collapse costs about 97% of the account in 2022, unless a 168h cooldown after losses is added. That variant still makes +10.51%/month but has a -62% drop with the collapse coins.
- 2026 to date runs at only about +5%/month.

The realistic expectation for a velocity version of the bot is roughly +4-9%/month with 30-45% drops. 10%/month is reachable only in a hindsight backtest with near-perfect fills.

r.lever: cycle: a faster bot that checks every 5 or 15 minutes (1 minute was also tested), with the trigger taken from a short 1-6h window of highs, quick take-profits and short time stops, holding 1-4 coins with concentrated orders. Spot only, every order fully funded, the 19 screened coins (plus LUNA/FTT/SRM in the stress runs).
r.designs_tried:
17,156 designs over 4 phases. Each was run twice: normal, and stressed (every buy 0.2% worse, plus LUNA/FTT/SRM at 0.1% slippage). Costs everywhere: 0.1% fee per side, 0.02% market slippage, limit fills only when price trades 0.1% through, take-profit placed at the next check (the live-bot rule).

How the code was built and checked: 1-minute candles were turned into 5m/15m/60m bars, one coin at a time. The new kernel (ckernel) reproduces engine.run bit for bit on the hourly candles: 7 settings, with and without the collapse coins. It also reproduces engine.mrun(delay=0) bit for bit on the 1-minute data. The 5m and 15m bars add up exactly to the 60m bars. Each later kernel (ckernel2, ckernel3) was proven identical to the one before it with its new switches off.

Phase 1, plain fast bot (7,680 settings): check {5, 15} min x window {1, 2, 3, 6}h x depth {4, 5, 6, 8, 10}% x take-profit {1, 1.5, 2, 3}% x time stop {2, 4, 6, 12}h x cooldown {0, 1, 2}h x sizing {1x100%, 2x50%, 3x33%, 4x25%}.

Phase 2 (6,912 settings): 144 entry settings x three collapse guards x three exits x an optional second, slow trigger.
- Guards: block a coin for 72h after a losing exit; sell at a check close 15% under entry; skip a coin whose open is more than 30% under its 7-day high.
- Exits: plain; trailing (once the take-profit is hit, sell on a 1% drop from the high since); waiting (take-profit active only 1h after the fill).
- Slow trigger: the 24h-high close minus 12%, alongside the fast one.

Phase 3: the phase-2 picks with 1-minute checks.

Phase 4 (2,562 combinations): a deep "wick layer" (512 settings, bids 15-40% under the 1h/3h high) in its own sub-account, at a weight a of 0.25, 0.5 or 1.0 next to the honest main bots.

Selection rules were written in each script before it ran. Rule A uses the normal 2021-23 run, rule B the stressed 2021-23 run (primary from phase 2 on). Each keeps settings with 2022 >= 0% and a 2021-23 drop no worse than -50%, then takes the highest 2021-23 %/month.

Caveats:
- Phases 2-4 were designed after seeing earlier results, including 2024-26.
- A stress-model artifact was found after phase 2. A position bought in a collapse coin's last data hour (e.g. FTT at its Sep 2023 reopen) stayed frozen forever, which froze an all-in account. A switch now sells it at the last real close.
- All stressed grids were re-run with that switch. The re-run was first shown to reproduce the stored rows exactly with the switch off. The rules were not changed.

r.risks:
- **Concentration.** Every setting that passes 10%/month puts 100% of the account in one coin. With LUNA/FTT/SRM included, the fast trigger buys a collapsing coin again and again: LUNA lost -24%, -81% and -98% of the account in three trades in a row. The 72h loss block and the 7-day-high skip make survival possible, but they also lower returns.
- **Fill quality.** Average gains of +0.4-0.6% per trade are small, so fills 0.2% worse on both sides turn the +11.27% design negative and the honest rule-A picks to about +0.5%/month.
- **A few big trades.** The 2024-26 hindsight results depend on a handful of trades, above all the 10 Oct 2025 flash crash. That event also produces the -78% to -80% marked drops in every 5m/1m design.
- **The 2021-23 bull market inflates the design period.** 2021 alone shows +5,961% for the honest pick. Design-period rankings did not carry over: the best rule-B2 qualifier made only +4.29%/month in 2024-26.
- **Bar-based fills.** The model fills a resting order on 5m/15m bars when price trades 0.1% through, and buys at the bar open. Real fills inside flash crashes may be worse.
- **The bot must be online every 5-15 minutes**, so outages and API limits matter.
- **Collapse coins are sold at their last real close** (the panel's cut). They kept trading in reality.
- **Multiple testing:** 17,156 designs, so the hindsight numbers are optimistic.
- **Halal rules all hold:** spot only, no leverage or borrowing, every order fully funded.
- **Possible issue in the original engine, not tested here:** a collapse coin bought in its last data hour stays frozen. At 20% sizing this is small, but it may affect the earlier 1-2 coin stress numbers in hr_stress.py.

r.summary:
A faster Panic Buyer does not get to 10%/month honestly, and it does worse than the hourly bot.

- **Honest pick:** chosen on stressed 2021-23 data only (5m checks, 1h high -10%, take-profit +1.5%, 6h stop, all-in, 72h block after a loss). 2024-26: +2.39%/month, with a -78% drop marked during the 10 Oct 2025 flash crash. Since 2025: +2.31%/month. Fully stressed: +1.92%/month.
- **Other honest picks:** +2.5% to +4.5%/month in 2024-26. The two higher ones (rule A, +4.3-4.5%/month) were chosen on survivor coins only; one is wiped out by LUNA once the collapse coins are included, and the other falls to about +0.5%/month with fills 0.2% worse on both sides.
- **Against the hourly bot:** the live hourly settings make +2.9%/month with a -16% drop, and the hourly 2-coin pick makes +5.5%/month. 1-minute checks change nothing material.
- **In hindsight:** 14 settings pass 10%/month in 2024-26 (best +11.27%). All are all-in on one coin. Each loses more than half its 2021-23 money, is wiped out once LUNA/FTT/SRM are included (the best one is still +4.78%/month in 2024-26 on the leftover crumbs), and owes a big share to one flash-crash trade (+249% on RENDER; +7.18%/month without it). The best stressed hindsight setting makes +10.08% normal and +8.32%/month stressed in 2024-26, but its 2021-23 drop is -63% (-88% stressed), so no 2021-23 rule would pick it.
- **Recommendation:** do not deploy a cycle design. Keep the live bot. The way to 10% in this data is one coin, all-in, with bigger risk, not a faster cycle.

r.lever: universe: more dips to catch. The bot trades screened halal coins (code/universe.py pass_map, delisted coins included; when a coin's data ends, an open position stays stuck at its last price). Coins are ranked at each month's first hour using only past data.    - watch mode instead of resting bids;

No lookahead, unfunded orders or unscreened coins found. The problems are fills more optimistic than real trading, survivorship, and hindsight selection:

1. The 1-minute hindsight designs depend on single-minute wick prints. I re-ran them on minute candles with every wick trimmed to 1% beyond the candle body, so resting orders cannot fill on isolated prints (2024-26 / since 2025):
   - hindsight best: 11.71 -> 8.03 / 10.06 -> 5.08;
   - LUNA-surviving variant: 10.51 -> 7.33;
   - round-3 pick: 9.23 -> 6.71;
   - universe H4 core at minute resolution: 9.97 -> 7.62.
   The honest round-1 pick barely moves: 6.32 -> 6.17, and the live bot goes 2.89 -> 2.48.

2. The flash crash of 10 Oct 2025 (real prints in the 1-minute data: RENDER 2.94 -> 0.426, SUI 3.20 -> 0.56):
   - The hindsight designs went all-in on RENDER six times that evening, +7.8% each. The +8% cap sells were filled by isolated prints, for example a minute high of 3.500 with a close of 2.159 at 21:53, and highs of 2.500 at 22:02 and 22:25. That size would not have filled.
   - One of those positions (100% of the account, entry 2.922) traded as low as 0.426 (-85%) inside the hour. The drawdown is measured on hourly marks, so it never shows.
   - With no new entries 20:00-24:00 UTC that evening, 2024-26 / since 2025 become: hindsight best 9.85 / 7.22, LUNA-surviving variant 8.69 / 5.88, round-3 pick 7.95 / 5.76, round-1 pick 6.37 / 3.80 (unaffected).
   - The cycle agent's hindsight +11.27% rests on a RENDER market buy at 0.594 in the same crash (+249%). Without that trade it is +7.18%.

3. Hourly watch mode (universe lever) is optimistic, because the order in which coins cross inside an hour is unknown.
   - H4 with only the adversarial order: 11.04 -> 9.00. With only 0.3% extra slippage: 10.25.
   - At 1-minute resolution, the 19-coin core of H4 falls from 10.52 (hourly watch) to 9.97 (watching every minute, buys rechecked hourly), 9.04 (rechecked every minute), 8.04 (one resting bid moved every minute) and 8.13 (hourly resting bid, the live mechanism).

Settings:
- Trigger 12% under the highest hourly close of the last 24 hours.
- 2 orders, each min(50% of the account, cash/2), fully funded.
- Buy check every minute. Bids move to the 2 eligible coins closest to their trigger. A coin already under its trigger at the minute's open is bought at market.
- 24h cooldown per coin.
- Exit active 1 minute after the fill. It arms when a 1-minute close reaches entry +3%, then sells at the next minute's open after the first close below the highest close since arming. A resting cap sell sits at +8%. Time stop 48h.

I checked all five levers. No lookahead, unfunded orders or unscreened coins turned up. I re-ran the velocity, idle and universe headline designs and the numbers match exactly.

No design reaches 10%/month under realistic fills.
- The best honest design is the velocity round-1 pick: 2 coins x 50%, 1-minute buy checks, a 12% trigger, a trailing exit armed at +3% with an +8% cap, 24h cooldown. 2024-26: +6.32%/month (drop -27%); since 2025: +3.72%/month (drop -27%); 2021-23: +16.13%/month.
- It is the one result that survives every check I added: order delays, worse fills, trimmed wicks and the flash-crash evening (range 3.2-6.5%/month). It drops to 3.9 / 2.2 with fills 0.2% worse and LUNA/FTT/SRM. It is also the top of a noisy group: the next 7 designs under the same rule made 4.8-6.0%.

The hindsight ceiling is +11.71%/month in 2024-26 (velocity, 1 coin all-in) and +10.06% since 2025. It rests on three things a real account would not get:
- single-minute wick fills: with wicks trimmed, 8.03 / 5.08;
- one flash-crash evening (10 Oct 2025, six all-in RENDER trades sold on isolated prints): without it, 9.85 / 7.22;
- near-perfect fills: with both order delays and fills 0.1% worse, 7.91.
It is also wiped out by a LUNA-type collapse. The universe agent's H4 (+11.04%) loses 1.5-2 points once the in-hour order is checked on minute data or made adversarial, and 2.4 more with wicks trimmed. The cycle agent's +11.27% is one +249% trade at a crash price.

Realistic hindsight ceiling: about 8-10%/month in 2024-26 and 5-7% since 2025. Realistic expectation for the bot: about 4-6%/month, with 27-45% drops.

Three finalists (exact settings above) are ready for the 2018-20 holdout. That is the only honest way left to test whether a 10% design generalizes.
